name: stunning screech
desc:
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} emits a horrific screech. Each creature within 20 feet of it that can hear it and that isn't a [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn .
